bio: Having gained experience abroad, Chef Rokas Vasiliauskas returned to his home city to open this delightful restaurant with his partner Greta – and their pride is palpable. The exterior exudes a back-to-nature feel thanks to its pale green colour scheme and blonde wood furnishings, and this natural approach extends to the cooking too. Jars of preserved ingredients line the walls, and they keep their focus on Lithuanian ingredients – you won’t find any citrus fruits, pepper or olive oil here. Dishes play on childhood memories and local heritage, and the creative interpretations of classic dishes are far more complex than they first appear.
